strategies.name: premarket_level_liquidity_sweep_reversal

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: after 3:00 a.m. Eastern time all the way up into New York market open
entry_sequence.action: Mark the pre-market range from 3:00 a.m. Eastern time until the 9:30 a.m. New York market open.
entry_sequence.rationale: This defines the high and low levels used for the sweep setup.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: mark the highest high of that price action and the lowest low of that price action
entry_sequence.action: Mark the highest high and the lowest low of that pre-market range as the key levels.
entry_sequence.rationale: These pre-market highs and lows are the sweep levels.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: A liquidity sweep is going to be a brief fake out below or above the level
entry_sequence.action: For short, wait for price to briefly break above the pre-market high and fail; for long, wait for price to briefly break below the pre-market low and fail.
entry_sequence.rationale: The setup is a fake breakout through the marked level.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: it comes back down and closes below
entry_sequence.action: For short, enter after price reclaims back below the pre-market high with confirmation; for long, enter after price reclaims back above the pre-market low with confirmation.
entry_sequence.rationale: The reclaim confirms the failed break has reversed.

stop.transcript_quote: The stop is always going to go on the opposite side of the entry candle.
stop.rationale: The speaker says the stop goes on the opposite side of the entry candle.

strategies.stop_management: Move the stop-loss to at least break even, ideally into profits, and continue trailing it as the trade moves in your favor.

targets.transcript_quote: bare minimum of 1x of my original risk
targets.rationale: The speaker says the minimum objective is 1x original risk.

targets.transcript_quote: what I'm looking for is a 1.5x to a 2x my original risk
targets.rationale: The speaker says the ideal target is 1.5x original risk.

targets.transcript_quote: what I'm looking for is a 1.5x to a 2x my original risk
targets.rationale: The speaker says the ideal extension can reach 2x original risk.

confluences.description: Use the pre-market range formed after 3:00 a.m. Eastern time into the New York open.

confluences.transcript_quote: these levels act as magnets and they act as traps
confluences.name: premarket_levels_as_traps
confluences.description: The speaker says the pre-market highs and lows act as magnets and traps.

confluences.transcript_quote: A liquidity sweep is going to be a brief fake out below or above the level
confluences.name: fakeout_through_level
confluences.description: The entry requires a brief fake out above or below the pre-market level.

confluences.name: failed_break_reclaim_confirmation
confluences.description: For a short, price must fail the break and close back below; for a long, it must reclaim back above the level.
